description: The shop's GraphQL API (POST /graphql, schema in api/schema.graphql) lets the new storefront read products: one product by id, or the whole list. Price changes are pushed to subscribers over WebSocket (graphql-transport-ws on /graphql).
acceptanceCriteria: Query product(id) returns the product's name and its price as a number.
Query products returns every product, without errors.
An unknown id returns null for product, without errors.
Subscription priceChanged(id) pushes the product's price, then its price after a 10 % markdown, then completes.
